description: This file defines the Thread class and related thread-local storage template within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal mechanisms for thread management, thread-local storage, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: ThreadLocalStorageType
classes.description: Template class managing thread-local storage for a specified type, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Class representing a thread, providing methods for thread control, priority, state management, and thread-local storage access.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType<>::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the thread-local storage manager.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType<>::Context
methods.description: Provides access to the thread-local storage instance for the current thread.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType<>::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if thread-local storage is set for the current thread.

methods.name: Thread::DefaultStackSize
methods.description: Returns the default stack size for threads.

methods.name: Thread::DefaultStackSize(const uint32_t)
methods.description: Sets the default stack size for threads.

methods.name: Thread::ExceptionCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for handling exceptions within threads (if __CORE_EXCEPTION_CATCHING__ is defined).

methods.name: Thread::Thread
methods.description: Constructor initializing a thread with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: Thread::~Thread
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up thread resources.

methods.name: Thread::Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread execution.

methods.name: Thread::Block
methods.description: Blocks the thread execution.

methods.name: Thread::Stop
methods.description: Stops the thread execution.

methods.name: Thread::Init
methods.description: Initializes the thread.

methods.name: Thread::Run
methods.description: Starts thread execution.

methods.name: Thread::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the thread.

methods.name: Thread::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: Thread::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the thread is currently running.

methods.name: Thread::IsBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the thread is currently blocked.

methods.name: Thread::IsFailed
methods.description: Checks if the thread has failed.

methods.name: Thread::PriorityMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::PriorityMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::Priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::Id
methods.description: Returns the thread's identifier.

methods.name: Thread::ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the current thread's identifier.

methods.name: Thread::GetContext
methods.description: Template method to access thread-local storage of a specific type.

methods.name: Thread::Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread.

methods.name: Thread::GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack for debugging (if __DEBUG__ is defined).

methods.name: Thread::Initialize
methods.description: Performs thread initialization tasks.

methods.name: Thread::Worker
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented with the thread's work logic.

methods.name: Thread::Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the thread.

methods.name: Thread::State
methods.description: Sets or gets the thread's state.

methods.name: Thread::ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread's name.

methods.name: Thread::SignalTermination
methods.description: Signals the thread to terminate.

methods.name: Thread::Lock
methods.description: Locks the thread's internal synchronization.

methods.name: Thread::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the thread's internal synchronization.
